name: unisal.ouvidoria
description: This project is a digital ombudsman portal developed for UNISAL, aiming to provide students with an accessible platform to submit suggestions, compliments, complaints, and other types of feedback. The system promotes open communication between the academic community and the institution, fostering continuous improvement through active listening.
